open_points.text: import_snapshot: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST make its own reads and writes, wherever its other notes call for them, of the records the SnapshotImportRepository holds through get_snapshot_by_identity of the snapshot_imports repository of that transaction, and through its insert_snapshot and its insert_snapshot_import.
open_points.rule: Нота остаётся требованием к поведению: выражения, вызовы методов, точечная навигация и строковый микро-синтаксис в ней запрещены.
open_points.question: The passage must state the repository dependency and required persistence behavior without prescribing method calls or navigation through the transaction and repository objects.
